status_definitions.released: Implemented in an announced release (independent native qualification still varies)
status_definitions.preview: Available as prerelease/preview; extra qualification required
status_definitions.sdk: Available via the owning language SDK, not a UI component

platforms.linux: Released wheel: glibc 2.39+; KDE Wayland targeted

features.name: Native windows
features.notes: Core host owns physical windows; CLI windows belong to commands.

features.name: Document text/attributes
features.notes: SDK document operations; UI does not duplicate Core API.

features.name: Document input/events
features.notes: CLI handles select/form interaction, not general event subscription.

features.name: HTML forms/selection
features.notes: SDK form API and CLI form; UI has labeled input/select.

features.name: Native file/folder dialogs
features.notes: Invoke from public language SDK, not a UI component.

features.name: HTML dialog and popover
features.notes: UI library has no modal abstraction.

features.name: Multiple windows
features.notes: UI examples mount a window; additional windows use SDK.

features.name: Clipboard and desktop services
features.notes: OS services are exposed through SDKs.

features.name: Live bitmap RGBA8
features.notes: Public bounded bitmap APIs, not video playback.

features.name: Reactive state/computed
features.notes: Python computed-state concurrency issue; see limitations.

features.name: Layout and compact components
features.notes: A deliberate small UI library, not a full browser widget set.

features.name: Audio/video media player
features.notes: Not implemented in current library scope.
